title: [GMCP 203.043.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Cross-platform packaging, service integration, and distribution
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-043-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Identical supported GMCP capability is packaged for Linux, macOS and Windows across x86_64 and arm64 with signed, reproducible artifacts, service-manager integration, upgrade/rollback, uninstall, path/permission handling and diagnostics. A declared parity matrix has automated clean-machine, non-admin, Unicode-path, sleep/resume and upgrade tests; unavoidable platform differences are explicit and policy-safe. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
